question: An exterior angle and an interior angle of a regular polygon are in the ratio of 1 ∶ 8. What is the number of sides of the polygon?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The sum of an interior and an exterior angle of a regular polygon is always 180°.

Ratio of Exterior : Interior = 1 : 8 ⇒ Total ratio parts = 1 + 8 = 9.

Exterior angle = (1 ÷ 9) × 180° = 20°.

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior angle = 360° ÷ 20° = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**
